issue.title: Docs: document REST API rate limits
issue.author: dx-team
issue.body: Add docs/api/rate-limits.md to the public REST API documentation. Document the Free plan limit of 60 requests/minute and the Pro plan limit of 600 requests/minute, HTTP 429 response structure and the Retry-After header. Add a curl example. Link the page from docs/api/overview.md and the docs navigation sidebar. Add a link check to the existing documentation CI suite.

issue.title: Make the dashboard faster
issue.author: product-team
issue.body: Users say the dashboard is sometimes slow. Improve it somehow, maybe caching? We are not sure which pages are affected or which response time is acceptable.

issue.title: Allow service accounts to bypass MFA with long-lived tokens
issue.author: platform-team
issue.body: Our CI service accounts cannot finish MFA during login. Proposal: modify auth/middleware.ts to bypass MFA for long-lived API tokens, extend JWT expiry to one year, relax RBAC for the service role, and store token secrets directly in the users database. Evaluate the implications and propose safer alternatives. No change is authorized.
